description: Case-insensitive substring search over market titles, event titles and tickers ('CPI', 'Kansas City'). The whole query must appear as written, so search one word or name at a time. Game-winner markets are usually titled by city, so a team nickname alone can miss them: try the city, or list_markets with a sport. Use this when you already know the event; list_markets with event_ticker then gives you every outcome. Set full=true to get every upstream field instead of the compact row.
name: search_markets
title: Search markets
